title: Moon Recession Will Eventually Shrink Total Eclipses
hook: The Moon is not escaping; it is slowly changing how eclipses look.
closing: We occupy a rare window when the Moon can fully cover the Sun.
question: Would you travel for totality?

segments.say: Since 1969, the Moon has receded 2.17 meters. The movement is gradual, not an escape from Earth.
The Moon now sits 384,400 kilometers away. That greater distance makes it look slightly smaller in our sky.
Total solar eclipses are projected to end in 600 million years. The geometry changes, not the Moon's orbit vanishing.
